VI.description: Reads where the front panel window of VI is on screen\2C for RemoteVI Translate Input.vi and the overlay. The browser shows the FRAME - the whole window below its title bar\2C i.e. its client area with LabVIEW's menu bar\2C toolbar\2C panel and scrollbars (RemoteVI Frame Rect.vi) - so the coordinates a client sends are frame coordinates\3A geo.panelX/panelY = the screen position of the frame's top-left corner (the point browser coordinates are relative to\3B the name is historical - it was the panel origin while only the panel was streamed)\2C geo.clientX/clientY = the screen position of the window's client-area origin (the negative of user32 ScreenToClient applied to the screen point 0\2C0). Both are the same point today\2C because the frame is the client area. origin = where the panel area (Front Panel Window\3APanel Bounds left/top) starts inside the frame - below the menu bar and the toolbar - sent to the clients as the text message origin x y (docs\5Cprotocol.md 3.3). Also returns the window handle (Front Panel Window\3AOS Window\2C sign-extended I32 to I64 to U64). A VI Server call\3A the server loop calls it before its first iteration and then every 500 ms while no popup is open. An incoming error skips the work.

Control.description: The VI whose front panel window receives the input.

Node.fields: read+Front Panel Window\3AOS Window,read+Front Panel Window\3APanel Bounds
Node.outputs: error out:pn.error out,Front Panel Window\3AOS Window:pn.Front Panel Window\3AOS Window,Front Panel Window\3APanel Bounds:pn.Front Panel Window\3APanel Bounds

Call.inputs: hWnd:hw.unsigned 64bit integer,Screen X:k0.value,Screen Y:k0.value,error in (no error):pn.error out
Call.outputs: Client X:stc.Client X,Client Y:stc.Client Y,return value:,error out:stc.error out

Indicator.description: Frame origin (panelX\2C panelY) and client-area origin (clientX\2C clientY) in screen coordinates.
Native handle of the front panel window.
Where the panel area starts inside the frame\2C in frame pixels (Panel Bounds left/top minus the frame origin).
